The Appointed Date for the merger shall be April 01, 2013. The entire paid-up equity share capital of Landmark, Fiora and Trexa is wholly owned by the Company, either directly or indirectly through its wholly owned subsidiary, hence, no shares of the Company will be issued and allotted pursuant to the proposed Scheme. Trent Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on May 25, 2011, inter alia, have approved the following : (1) Recommended payment of dividend @ 0.1% per annum i.e. 1.02 paise per CCPS Series A of Rs. 10/- each on 44,51,414 CCPS Series A from the date of allotment, i.e. August 28, 2010 and up to the date on which the CCPS Series A are compulsorily and automatically converted into one fully paid up Equity share of Rs. 10 each i.e. September 01, 2011. A record date will be fixed at a later date in consultation with the Stock Exchanges to ascertain who would be eligible for the allotment of the fully paid up equity shares and the payment of dividend; (2) Also, recommended payment of Dividend @ 0.1% i.e. Re. 1 per Redeemable Preference Share of Rs. 1000/- each, on 70,000 Preference Shares, for approval by the shareholders.

Trent Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company had issued 44,51,414 Cumulative Compulsorily Convertible Preference Shares (CCPS) Series-A of Rs.10 each for Rs.550 per share ( ISIN- INE849A03018) to the shareholders on a rights basis in the month of August 2010. As per the Letter of Offer, One CCPS Series-A of face value of Rs. 10 each will be compulsorily and automatically converted into one fully paid-up Equity Share of Rs.10 each on September 01 2011, without any application or any further act on the part of the CCPS Series -A holder. The CCPS Series-A holders are also entitled to Dividend. The Company has fixed August 23, 2011 as the Common Record Date, to ascertain the details of those CCPS Series-A holders whose names appear as beneficial owners in the records of the depositories and/or whose names appear on the Register of Members of the Company as on the Record Date for: (1) Compulsory and automatic conversion of One CCPS Series-A into One Equity Share of Rs10/- each; and (2) Payment of dividend @ 0.1% p.a. i.e. Paise 1.02 per CCPS Series A for the period from the date of allotment of CCPS Series- A i.e. August 28, 2010 and up to the date on which CCPS Series-A are compulsorily and automatically converted into fully paid-up Equity Shares i.e. September 01, 2011. The dividend on CCPS Series-A shall be paid on and after September 02, 2011, after the same has been approved by the shareholders at the forthcoming Annual General Meeting scheduled on 5th August 2011.
